data.body: Plan-review advisory disposition: use the completion workflow recorder's existing per-step `duration_ms`, grouped by `step_id`, at the local completion-dispatch seam. Do not add clocks or hooks to the shared workflow interpreter/executor. Emit concrete precheck/context, completion-agent, reconcile, no-LLM passthrough, unclassified-step, and explicit residual fields; retain `verifier_workflow_ms` only as the aggregate. Compute the integer-ms residual after flooring the recorded partitions so each newly emitted record reconciles exactly; the reusable probe allows a documented 1 ms tolerance for serialization/rounding compatibility. This adds only one bounded in-memory pass over the recorder records and sidecar dictionary construction.
